js-order-total.alternative: function orderTotal(items){let total=0;for(const {price,quantity} of items)total+=price*(quantity??1);return total;}
js-order-total.wrong-round: function orderTotal(items){let total=0;for(const item of items)total+=item.price*(item.quantity??1);return Math.round(total*100)/100;}
js-order-total.wrong-mutate: function orderTotal(items){let total=0;for(const item of items){item.quantity??=1;total+=item.price*item.quantity;}return total;}

js-frequency-map.alternative: function frequencies(values){const counts=new Map();for(const value of values){const previous=counts.get(value)||0;counts.set(value,previous+1);}return counts;}
js-frequency-map.wrong-clone-key: function frequencies(values){const counts=new Map();for(const value of values){const key=structuredClone(value);counts.set(key,(counts.get(key)||0)+1);}return counts;}
js-frequency-map.wrong-nan: function frequencies(values){const counts=new Map();for(const value of values){if(Number.isNaN(value))continue;counts.set(value,(counts.get(value)||0)+1);}return counts;}
